title: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros Disclosed 19 Stock Trades: Benchmark, ON Semi, Semtech and More (Sep-Oct 2026)
content:

Transaction dates: Sep 28 to Oct 1, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 12, 2026 (11 to 14 days later). Member: Rep. Gilbert Cisneros, CA-31 (House). Bargo gives no price estimate for the Thermon (THR) exchange line.

What's been disclosed

  • 11 purchases: including Benchmark Electronics (BHE) and ON Semiconductor (ON) in the $15,001–$50,000 band, plus Advanced Energy (AEIS), Allegro MicroSystems (ALGM), Cytokinetics (CYTK), Gates Industrial (GTES), YETI, Tandem Diabetes (TNDM), Ultragenyx (RARE), Praxis Precision (PRAX) and Alkermes (ALKS) at $1,001–$15,000.
  • 7 sales: MACOM (MTSI) and ITT in the $15,001–$50,000 band, plus Semtech (SMTC), Oxford Industries (OXM), Halozyme (HALO), BridgeBio (BBIO) and AtriCure (ATRC) at $1,001–$15,000.
  • One exchange: Thermon Group (THR), $15,001–$50,000, on October 1.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Benchmark Electronics about 28.6% lower on November 6 than on October 1, Advanced Energy about 30.5% lower and Allegro MicroSystems about 23.0% lower than on September 29. Semtech, which was sold, is about 42.7% lower than at the sale date.
  • Timing: the filing came 11 to 14 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
11 to 14 days after the trades, which were dated September 28 to October 1. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 6 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.

What does "exchange" mean in a filing?
It is a transaction type listed separately from a purchase or a sale; the data Bargo carries does not explain it further.
